extracted.name: Hawaiian French Toast Casserole
extracted.description: This Hawaiian French Toast Casserole is so tropical and fresh from the coconut and pineapple, you will think you're waking up on the beach! It uses just a few pantry ingredients and Hawaiian rolls for an effortless crowd-pleasing breakfast everyone will love!
ingredient_lines: 12 Hawaiian Sweet Rolls (, cut into cubes)
2 Tablespoons macadamia nuts (, chopped, or almonds)
instruction_lines: Mix eggs, whole milk, sugar, vanilla, coconut extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, pineapple, and coconut in a bowl.
Add cut up Hawaiian rolls and stir well to coat. Transfer mixture to an 8 or 9inch greased baking dish. Set aside while you make the topping.
Topping: Combine flour, brown sugar and cinnamon. Cut in butter with a fork, until crumbly. Stir in nuts. Sprinkle topping over casserole.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until golden and set.
Serve warm plain, or with syrup.
